subject: Request: Convalescent return and accommodations
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Convalescent return and accommodations

Hi Rishi / Laura,

I wanted to confirm next steps for my return-to-work after the surgery. My doctor has recommended a convalescent re-entry with the following temporary restrictions for about 6 weeks: no more than 6 hours/day at the desk, no overnight travel, limited repetitive typing (voice-to-text when possible), and no heavy lifting. I have attached the occupational clearance from Dr. Santos and a draft modified-duty agreement for your review.

My rough preference would be: 4x6-hour days the first 2 weeks, then re-evaluate for a gradual increase. I'm open to a staggered shift that helps coverage.

Can HR confirm how this interacts with my short-term disability and whether Redwood can implement a temporary modified schedule and ergo assessment? Also please confirm who will own coverage for my on-call rotations during this period.

Attachments: emily_santos_clearance.pdf (PDF), modified-duty-agreement.docx (DOCX)

Thanks — I want to make sure this goes smoothly for the team and that I can ramp back safely.

— Olga
Olga Petrov | Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Convalescent return and accommodations

Olga — thanks for the heads up and for sharing Dr. Santos's note. Really glad you're taking the time you need.

Operationally, I can cover critical customer escalations for the first two weeks and will offload the on-call rota where needed. Proposed coverage plan (high level):
- Week 1–2: 4 days x 6 hours; I pick up urgent on-call issues; rotation paused for Olga.
- Week 3–4: move to 5 days x 6 hours with progressively more async work.
- Week 5–6: increase to ~80% time and review.

Laura — can HR confirm short-term disability pay cadence and whether we can formalize a modified-duty schedule immediately? Also please advise if we should book an on-site ergonomic assessment with Ergo Solutions next week.

Olga, once HR confirms, I'll update the team and publish a brief coverage calendar.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Engineering Manager
redwood.inference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Convalescent return and accommodations

Hi Olga — thanks for sending the clearance. Quick note on process and next steps from People / Benefits: 

1) Benefits / pay: Short-term disability (STD) paperwork has to be submitted to Acme Benefits; payroll will process STD payments retroactively once approved. Please complete the STD form and attach Dr. Santos's clearance (I can upload on your behalf with consent).

2) ADA / accommodations: We can implement a temporary modified-duty agreement. I reviewed the draft you attached; I made a few administrative edits and attached a version for signature (modified-duty-agreement.docx). Once signed, we'll set the schedule and notify the team leads.

3) Schedule suggestion: To balance continuity and recovery, HR recommends: 4x6 hours (weeks 1–2), 5x6 hours (weeks 3–4), 5x7 hours (weeks 5–6) with a formal review at week 6. We are flexible to align with medical guidance.

4) Ergonomics: We can schedule an on-site assessment with Ergo Solutions (Ergo Solutions <hello@ergosolutions.com>). Please let me know preferred days next week for a 45-minute assessment.
5) Documentation: I've opened case HR-CASE-2319 for your file and added a Drive folder for all RTW docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHR-RTW-OlgaPetrov
Next steps for Olga: sign the attached modified-duty agreement and confirm times/days for the ergo visit. For payroll, reply to confirm you want HR to submit forms to Acme Benefits.
Attachments: modified-duty-agreement.docx

— Laura Bennett
Senior People Business Partner | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
From: Dr. Emily Santos <emily.santos@occupationalhealth.org>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Occupational clearance for Olga Petrov

Hi Olga / Laura — 

Thank you for the summary. Confirming per my exam that the recommendation stands: no more than 6 hours seated work/day for at least two weeks, avoid repetitive wrist flexion (hence voice-to-text recommendations), avoid overnight travel for 6 weeks, and no heavy lifting. I have attached my formal clearance note.
If Olga experiences increased pain or swelling, we should re-evaluate earlier. Happy to sign off on increased duties once Olga is asymptomatic and comfortable with the workload.
Attachment: emily_santos_clearance.pdf
— Dr. Emily Santos, MD
Occupational Health Associates
emily.santos@occupationalhealth.org
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>, Dr. Emily Santos <emily.santos@occupationalhealth.org>
Date: 2026-06-21T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Convalescent return and accommodations

Thanks all — I signed the modified-duty agreement and uploaded the signed copy to Drive (also attaching here). I would appreciate the ergo assessment on Tuesday 2026-06-23 if that works for the Ergo team.
I will also submit the STD form, Laura — yes, please upload on my behalf and submit to Acme Benefits.
Attachments: signed-modified-duty.pdf
On Fri, Jun 19, 2026 at 08:30 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com> wrote:
> Hi Olga — thanks for sending the clearance. Quick note on process and next steps from People / Benefits:
> ...

— Olga
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Convalescent return and accommodations — weekly check-ins and milestones

Thanks for coordinating this team. A couple of quick leadership-level notes:

- Appreciate the clear plan. Please set up a 15-minute weekly check-in between Olga and Rishi for the first six weeks (short status + blocker review).
- We'll treat week-6 as a formal evaluation milestone — schedule a 30-minute review on or around 2026-07-16 to confirm a return-to-full-duty or next steps.
- Rishi, if there are any project deadlines that absolutely cannot be shifted, flag them to me and we'll identify temporary backfill.
Rishi: confirm you have the interim coverage.
— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Head of People Operations
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com
